organization.fullName: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology

identificationModule.briefTitle: Zoledronic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic Breast Cancer, Metastatic Prostate Cancer, or Multiple Myeloma With Bone Involvement
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Phase III Study of Standard Dosing Versus Longer Dosing Interval of Zoledronic Acid in Metastatic Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm I (zoledronic acid every 4 weeks)
armGroups.description: Patients receive zoledronic acid IV over at least 15 minutes every 4 weeks for up to 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm II (zoledronic acid every 12 weeks)
armGroups.description: Patients receive zoledronic acid IV over at least 15 minutes every 12 weeks for up to 2 years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
